chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which are eight attributes from the attributes of Majesty.
ai.seo_question: What are the eight attributes of Divine Majesty mentioned in Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha presents a concise theological enumeration of eight attributes of Divine Majesty (Al-Jalal), reflecting the Shia emphasis on Tawhid and the transcendence of God beyond human comprehension. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the balance between God's majesty and mercy, often cited in sermons to inspire awe and spiritual refinement among the faithful.
